name: Runner Extras - report execution entry points
brief: Establishes which report entry points (Report.Run, instance Run, instance SaveAs, Report.SaveAs) actually execute a report's triggers and data item body.
description: Control experiment. A probe report over a NORMAL table was observed not to execute at all through Report.Run(): OnPreReport never fired, no error was raised and no output was produced — a silent no-op, the same class as an empty virtual table or emit-only state lost on a cache hit. A report that never runs produces no PDF and raises no error, which is exactly what the Pageworks pdf-render and asserterror-not-thrown clusters report. This suite pins each entry point separately, over a real table with real rows, so the boundary between 'executes' and 'silently does nothing' is explicit rather than inferred, and so a fix cannot regress one entry point while fixing another.
